name: Character Origin Selection and Inheritance

upbringings.description: Select one effective Upbringing. A Species or Ancestry default is a suggestion, not an extra automatically granted Upbringing and not a Species restriction. An explicit Upbringing choice replaces the suggested default. The selected Upbringing inherits any Upbringing parent benefits once, without requiring a second selection.

reviewNotes: This rule records already established Pillar 1 and Pillar 3 selection boundaries; it does not decide whether parent Upbringings should remain independently selectable.
Mixed Ancestry is a separate design question and is not required for directly selected Species and Ancestry.
Character selection and grant authorization remain unimplemented; this JSON is authoritative content rather than an executable character builder.
